title: Protocol for the identification and expression analysis of a cytoplasmic membrane-localized protein STING
protocol: Collect 3 mL of blood into 5 mL EDTA anti-coagulation tubes.
Dilute collected blood with sterile PBS to a total volume of 6 mL.
Gently layer diluted blood (4 mL) on top of 4 mL Ficoll-Hypaque solution in a tube.
Centrifuge the tube at 300 g for 30 minutes.
Transfer the intermediate foggy layer from the centrifuged solution into a new tube.
Centrifuge the transferred layer at 300 g for 10 minutes.
Resuspend the cell pellet in 1 mL of RBC lysis buffer and incubate for 2 minutes.
Wash cells by resuspending them in 5 mL PBS after centrifugation at 300 g.
Sacrifice and immerse the mouse in 75% ethanol.
Expose the spleen.
Harvest fresh spleens from WT or C57BL/6J-Sting1gt/J mice.
Gently crush spleens in sterile PBS using the inner piston of a syringe.
Suspend splenocytes in 10 ml PBS.
Filtrate suspended cells with a filter mesh (100 μm).
Centrifuge filtered suspension at 300 g for 10 min.
Resuspend cell precipitation in 1 ml RBC lysis buffer.
Incubate the resuspended cells for 2 min to remove red blood cells.
Repeat centrifugation and resuspension with PBS twice.
Resuspend cells in 5 ml PBS after concentrating.
Resuscitate splenocytes with 4 ml RPMI 1640.
Immerse the mouse in 75% ethanol.
Expose the spleen.
Place the spleen in a sterile collection tube.
Place the spleen in a sterile dish containing 4 mL PBS.
Grind the spleen.
Transfer the ground spleen cells to a cell strainer.
Create a single-cell suspension of spleen cells.
Centrifuge at 300 g for 10 min at 4°C.
Discard the supernatant.
Add 2 mL RBC lysis buffer.
Centrifuge and discard the supernatant.
Resuspend and count splenocytes.
Extract total proteins using RIPA buffer with protease inhibitor PMSF and phosphatase inhibitors.
Add 100 μL precooled RIPA lysate per million cells.
Quantify the proteins using a BCA Kit.
Separate equal amounts of protein by electrophoresis.
Transfer the separated proteins onto a PVDF membrane, loading 50 μg for PBMCs and 40 μg for splenocytes.
Block membranes with 5% BSA at 25°C for 1 hour.
Incubate with anti-STING rabbit polyclonal antibody diluted at 1:600 in PBST overnight at 4°C.
Incubate PVDF membranes with anti-STING rabbit polyclonal antibody diluted at 1:600 in PBST for 2 hours at 25°C.
Wash the membranes three times with PBST, each wash lasting 10 minutes.
Incubate the membranes with peroxidase-conjugated secondary antibodies (diluted at 1:2000 in PBST) for 1 hour at 37°C.
Wash the membranes three times with PBST, each wash lasting 10 minutes.
Image the membranes with an ECL kit and Bio-Rad Gel Doc XR+ system.
Extract total RNA using Trizol reagent according to the manufacturer's instructions.
Store resulting RNA at −80°C for up to 1 month.
Synthesize cDNA from 1 μg of total RNA using Reverse Transcriptase M-MLV (RNase H) following the manufacturer’s protocol.
Store resulting cDNA at −20°C for up to 1 year.
Incubate human PBMCs and mouse splenocytes (one million cells per group) with anti-STING antibody diluted by PBS at 4°C for 1 h.
Wash the cells twice with 1 mL PBS.
Stain the cells with FITC-conjugated secondary antibody diluted with PBS at 25°C in a dark place for 1 h.
Wash the cells twice with PBS (300 g, 5 min).
Resuspend the cells with 500 μL PBS.
Filter the cells through a filter mesh (50 μm).
Examine all samples by BD LSR Fortessa and analyze them with FlowJo 10.6.1 software.
Prepare clean polylysine-treated slides.
Blow ten million cells evenly with 1 mL PBS.
Absorb 30 μL suspension liquid with a pipette and drop it on the slide.
Let the liquid spread freely to form a monolayer cell structure.
Allow the cell suspension to dry freely at 25°C.
Use a hydrophobic barrier pen to circle the edge of the dried sample.
Fix the slides with 2% cold paraformaldehyde (PFA) for 5 min.
Block the slides in PBS containing 1% BSA for 30 min.
Wash the slides twice with cold PBS.
Perform staining with anti-STING antibody at a dilution of 1:200 in PBS for 14 h at 4°C.
Stain samples with fluorochrome-conjugated antibodies against cell surface markers at 4°C for 30 min in a dark place.
Wash the slides three times with cold PBST.
Incubate the samples with Alexa Fluo 594-conjugated goat anti-rabbit IgG at a dilution of 1:200 at 25°C for 1 h in a dark place.
Perform the nuclear staining by DAPI at 25°C for 10 min.
Wash the samples with cold PBST to ensure cells are submerged in PBST.
Seal the slides with a sealing agent.
Capture images using Nikon C2 confocal microscope.
Synthesize de novo the DNA sequence encoding mouse or human erSTING ORF fused EGFP or 3×Flag, and mouse or human pmSTING ORF fused EGFP or 3×Flag respectively.
Clone the synthesized sequences into pcDNA3.1 vector.
Transfect the human erSTING-EGFP, erSTING-3×Flag or pmSTING-EGFP, pmSTING-3×Flag plasmid into HEK293T cells using jetPRIME transfection regent according to manufacturer’s instruction.
Transfect the mouse erSTING-EGFP, erSTING-3×Flag or pmSTING-EGFP, pmSTING-3×Flag plasmid into B16-Blue™ ISG-KO-STING cells to express erSTING or pmSTING independently.
Seed 200,000 cells in 6-well plates per well and transfect cells at 60% confluency using 2 μg plasmid DNA per well.
Fix erSTING-Flag, pmSTING-Flag, or Flag plasmid transfected B16-Blue™ ISG-KO-STING or HEK293T cells with 2% cool PFA for 5 minutes.
Block the fixed samples with 1% BSA for 30 minutes.
Wash the samples twice with cold PBS to ensure the cells on the slides are submerged in PBS.
Incubate the slides with primary antibody against Flag (14793S, 1:400) at 4°C for 14 hours.
Rewarm the slides at 25°C for 20 minutes.
Stain the slides with WGA Lectin (FITC) (GTX01502, 1:500) diluted in PBS for 15 minutes at 25°C in a dark place.
Wash the slides three times with cold PBST to ensure the cells on the slides are submerged in PBST.
Stain the slides with Alexa Fluo 594-conjugated goat anti-rabbit IgG (ab150080, 1:200) diluted in PBS for 1 hour at 25°C in a dark place.
Perform nuclear staining by DAPI at 25°C for 10 minutes.
Wash the slides with cold PBST and seal them with a sealing agent.
Capture images using Nikon C2 confocal microscope.
Transfect pmSTING-EGFP or erSTING-EGFP into B16-Blue™ ISG-KO-STING cells using jetPRIME transfection regent according to manufacturer’s instructions.
Seed 200,000 cells in a 6-well plate per well and transfect at 60% confluency with 2 μg of plasmid DNA per well.
Incubate the transfected cells for 24 hours.
Incubate the cells with rabbit anti-STING antibody (5 μg/mL), rabbit anti-GAPDH antibody (5 μg/mL), and rabbit IgG isotype (5 μg/mL) in PBS at 4°C for 1 hour.
Collect cell pellets by centrifugation at 6000 g for 5 minutes.
Resuspend the pellets with RIPA buffer containing PMSF on ice for 10 minutes.
Centrifuge the samples at 4°C, 10,000 g, for 20 minutes to collect supernatant.
Detect IgG binding on the cell membrane using HRP-conjugated goat anti-rabbit IgG (1:2000).
